summary: Activation now requires a matching successful version 1 pi-subagents ping within 2000 ms. Failures show the required installation sentence. Existing checks, UI-only notices, history isolation, and deactivation behavior remain intact.

acceptanceCriteria.probe: npm run check: existing extensions/maestro.integration.test.ts valid-checks test supplies a matching successful reply after 100 ms, observes active state and preserved notice, and confirms no model request or agent delegation.

npm run check: no-ping-reply integration test uses controlled timers, observes an unfinished activation without notification at 1999 ms, then observes the required UI installation error and inactive state at 2000 ms.

npm run check: matching-reply integration cases reject success:false with Unavailable, null, invalid envelope/data versions, wrong method, missing data, and missing requestId. Emission-error test throws Bus unavailable. All remain inactive with the required installation sentence.

Inspected src/maestro/checks/assertEnvironment.ts lines 124–190 and extensions/maestro.ts lines 74–117 using nl -ba and sed. Each check creates one request and has one emission. Timeout rejects; finally removes the listener and timer; command failure only notifies and returns. No automatic retry path or dedicated retry test was added.

npm run check: existing successful-activation test compares session entries and model context. No-ping-reply test starts with three saved entries, activates successfully, deactivates, times out without a responder, and verifies identical entries after success and failure.
npm run check: existing active-Maestro/agents-unavailable integration test activates using a controlled responder, removes it, and observes zero event emissions during successful deactivation.

npm run check: existing failed-check/retry integration test has a successful controlled responder available but an untrusted project. Activation remains off and reports Project is not trusted. Environment tests also preserve agent discovery, configuration, model, and read-only checks.

notes: npm run check passed: lint, TypeScript checks, 37 test files, and 212 tests. git diff --check passed.
Controlled replies also verified that late replies cannot activate Maestro, later attempts use fresh request IDs, and replies from another request cannot satisfy the check.
No live pi-subagents responder or executor was used for ping verification. Dependencies and configuration were unchanged.
The pre-existing ROADMAP.md priority change was preserved. Added implementation status with independent verification pending, and updated README activation documentation.
Temporary test projects were cleaned by the test harness. Generated coverage output was removed.
